hooks.command:
ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then printf '%s
' 'Ouroboros hook skipped: plugin root is unavailable.' >&2; exit 0; fi; SCRIPT="$ROOT/scripts/session-start.py"; if [ ! -r "$SCRIPT" ]; then printf '%s
' "Ouroboros hook skipped: $SCRIPT is unavailable." >&2; exit 0; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON=python; else printf '%s
' 'Ouroboros hook skipped: Python is unavailable.' >&2; exit 0; fi; "$PYTHON" "$SCRIPT" || { STATUS=$?; printf '%s
' "Ouroboros hook failed open: $SCRIPT exited with code $STATUS." >&2; exit 0; }
hooks.commandWindows: try { $OutputEncoding=[Console]::InputEncoding=[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $root=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT; if (!$root) { $root=$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (!$root) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook skipped: plugin root is unavailable.'); exit 0 }; $script=Join-Path -Path $root -ChildPath 'scripts/session-start.py' -ErrorAction Stop; if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $script -PathType Leaf)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook skipped: '+$script+' is unavailable.'); exit 0 }; foreach ($name in @('python','python3')) { $python=Get-Command $name -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (!$python) { continue }; try { $executable=& $python.Source -X utf8 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(1) if sys.version_info.major != 3 else print(sys.executable)' 2>$null } catch { continue }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $executable -isnot [string]) { continue }; if (![System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($executable) -or [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($executable) -ne '.exe' -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $executable -PathType Leaf)) { continue }; & $executable -X utf8 $script; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook failed open: '+$script+' exited with code '+$LASTEXITCODE+'.') }; exit 0 }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook skipped: Python 3 is unavailable.') } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Ouroboros hook failed open: '+$_.Exception.Message) }; exit 0
